description: This file contains utility functions and shape checks for dilated convolution operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including size calculations and validation functions for tensors involved in dilated convolution forward and backward passes.

methods.name: all_positive
methods.description: Checks if all elements in an IntArrayRef are greater than zero.

methods.name: all_nonnegative
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a vector of int64_t are greater than or equal to zero.
